analysis.classification: Interpretation of exact matched native records, not invented native fields
analysis.sourceBaseline: internal/services/kinesis/audit.go as read before capture; source paths and authoritative model shape IDs recorded separately

differences.finding: Enhanced monitoring and shard-count controls emit native responseElements, unlike baseline nil Response projection
DescribeStreamSummary and generic resource tag/policy controls have empty LookupEvents Resources even when detail resources is populated
Legacy mutating stream controls selected by name use name history aliases; baseline canonical-ARN fallback is too broad
Name-selected DeregisterStreamConsumer uses versionless consumer detail ARN, with separate stream ARN and consumer name history aliases
Denied management calls redact requestParameters to explicit null and have empty history Resources; ResourceNotFound retains request parameters and ordinary action aliases
ListShards AT_LATEST returned closed parent plus live children immediately after split; filter returned shards by absence of EndingSequenceNumber before merging
Delivered denied data calls have requestParameters and responseElements null, category Data/readOnly true, CloudTrail errorCode AccessDenied (SDK AccessDeniedException)
Delivered missing ARN-selected PutRecord request streamARN is native null display ARN, not requested canonical ARN; resources contains canonical requested ARN and null display ARN
Start/StopStreamEncryption history aliases include AWS::KMS::Key with literal supplied key ID alias/aws/kinesis in addition to selected stream name/ARN; detail resources includes only stream
UpdateMaxRecordSize emits detail stream resource but empty history aliases
No-input DescribeLimits and DescribeAccountSettings audit requestParameters/responseElements are explicit null, detail resources omitted, history Resources empty

With owned display/principal selectors, denied name-selected PutRecord and iterator-only GetRecords deliver only malformed name-display stream resource, without canonical ARN/accountId; explicit-ARN GetRecords denial uses canonical resource
Missing-name PutRecord emits null-display ARN in requestParameters, and both requested-name display resource and null-display resource; neither detail resource contains accountId

captureCorrections.label: merge-shards-arn
captureCorrections.reason: Primary split result included closed parent, so dedicated two-shard owned stream used for safe successful merge.

Streaming command ignores cli-input-json required Bucket/Key. Initial CLIError downloads were client-only; changed to existing cloudwatch_audit_probe.py explicit --bucket/--key pattern. Listing and trail delivery were successful, not delivery absence.

captureCorrections.issue: Shared persistent Eval global bucket changed to an ISO timestamp during capture, producing CLI-only list-objects-v2 failures with no AWS request IDs
captureCorrections.resolution: Restored bucket from owned.bucket and downloaded all actual objects before deleting bucket. Every expanded-selector data repetition then matched exactly. Earlier client listing failures are not evidence of native event absence or delivery latency.

analysis.selectorBoundary: First selector set matched canonical owned stream ARN prefix. After actual data delivery showed selective absence for name/iterator calls, added only owned malformed display-ARN prefix and owned-role userIdentity.arn selector; late calls after another 300-second settle test those distinct selectors. Initial absent calls remain unknown.

reproduction.eventCorrelation: Use only calls[*].requestIDs matched exactly to CloudTrailEvent.requestID and S3 Records[*].requestID. historyAliases is distinct from native detail.resources.
reproduction.filterCaveat: Original canonical ARN selector cannot establish absence for calls projected to only display/null resources. Expanded selector experiment is explicitly a separate configuration epoch.
